The '''PDW-50 Ionic Tingler''' was a weapon produced by [[Aeramaxis Technologies|Aeramaxis]]. It was lightweight personal defense weapon that could be easily disguised as a small container. The Ionic Tingler featured a horizontal clip with five soft-shell cartridges attached to the base of the weapon. [[Ionic pulse regulator]]s energized [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] particles within the ammunition. When fired, the shell's covering disintegrated upon impact, blasting the target with charged plasma particles.
